title: Material-aware Blender 5.2 localization of the B62 close-shot framing failure
question: After volume-only geometry is traversed instead of treated as an opaque surface, does CLOSE_REFLECTION have a reproducible extreme-helmet-framing signature that is absent from both readable controls?

derivationDisclosure.knownConfound: B62_ATMOSPHERE is a closed mesh whose sole material has a linked Volume socket and no linked Surface socket. Blender scene.ray_cast reports its geometric boundary even though it is not an opaque visual surface.

materialAwareTraversal.passThroughDefinition: An object is VOLUME_ONLY_PASS_THROUGH only when every non-empty material slot uses nodes, has a Material Output node with linked Volume input, and has no Material Output node with linked Surface input. All other hit objects are VISUAL_BLOCKER.

measurements: exact material-slot and Material Output Surface/Volume linkage roster for every ray-hit owner
per-grid-ray skipped pass-through intersections and first visual-blocker owner/group/distance
dominant visual-blocker owner/share and character visual-blocker share
center-ray pass-through chain and first visual blocker
material-aware exact-target visibility for each semantic anchor
character evaluated-vertex unclamped projection bounds, on-screen vertex fraction and clamped union area
design.primaryAndIndependentImplementations: Two fresh Blender processes use separate Python files and may not import each other. They must agree on exact integer rosters, names and classifications; floating measurements use absolute tolerance 1e-9.

diagnosticSignature.controlsRequired: Neither readable control may satisfy every close-required condition.
diagnosticSignature.scope: The thresholds are openly derived from D1 and localize this one known failed frame. They are not a general composition score, a production threshold, or holdout evidence.

sequence: Commit and push D1 v0.2 evidence, this exact spec and its protocol while all four new tools and the formal root are absent.
Implement and statically validate two independent Blender observers plus runner and Node auditor.
Commit and push exact tool bytes; require synchronized origin/main and clean scoped paths.
Create one fresh immutable root, write admission before child launch and retain every failure.
Run the independent Node auditor only after both Blender children pass.

output.immutableFailurePolicy: Any failure preserves the root. Repair requires a preregistered correction and a fresh root.

decision.supportedWhen: All bindings and budgets pass, both Blender implementations agree, B62_ATMOSPHERE is proven volume-only pass-through, CLOSE satisfies the complete signature, and neither readable control does.
decision.invalidated: Any input/tool/runtime/process/resource/output mismatch, traversal exhaustion, render call, mutation or auditor failure yields scientificVerdict null.

nonClaims: This experiment does not correct a camera or authorize camera changes.
Volume-only traversal is a diagnostic visibility rule, not a physically based volume integrator.
The openly derived thresholds cannot serve as an independent holdout or a general cinematic-quality gate.
No claim is made about motion, temporal occlusion, complete-sequence quality, photorealism or human preference.
